name: Rena
source:
[spoiler]In the Haruiro branch, Yoichi relinquishes his ownership of the Artifact to Kakeru during the fight against Iris. She maintains her appearance and part of her personality under Kakeru - albeit seemingly no longer as bloodthirsty as she was under Yoichi. 

She appears to want a new nickname, as introducing herself as Ghost tends to cause unnecessary trouble.[/spoiler]
translation:
[spoiler]In the Haruiro branch, Yoichi relinquishes his ownership of the Artifact to Kakeru during the fight against Iris. She maintains her appearance and part of her personality under Kakeru - albeit seemingly no longer as bloodthirsty as she was under Yoichi. 

She appears to want a new nickname, as introducing herself as Ghost tends to cause unnecessary trouble.[/spoiler]
